The '''Corellian Hegemony''' was a group of a [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that joined [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and refused to take part in the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] and align neither with [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] or [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].

The Corellian Hegemony was an area representing one quarter of the Republic, located around and between the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was divided in two regions known as the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] and the [[77 Sectors]]. The Corellian Hegemony included [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Belazura]], [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], [[Foless/Legends|Foless]], [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]], [[Harrin/Legends|Harrin]], [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]], [[Chardaan/Legends|Chardaan]], [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] and [[Allanteen VI/Legends|Allanteen VI]].
